audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave Yone all seven rows while content and the packet both gave rows 5 and 6 to Aurelion Sol, and full phases[6].why already read 'You are the scaling endgame' under a row labelled Yone.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol is at 50.34% over 872 games. Yone owns levels 1-6: Mortal Steel is a free 4s ability that dashes and knocks up at two stacks, Spirit Cleave shields every 14s and gets faster with attack speed, and Soul Unbound falls from 22s to 10s. From the first item 750 of beam range beats his 450, and the black hole punishes the forced snap-back.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side moved Yone -> Aurelion Sol to match win[5]/win[6], with phases[5].why rewritten in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and prose named four abilities that do not exist: 'Starsurge', 'Comet of the Legend', 'Comet', and 'Voice of Light'. They also promised a 'Q stun' and a 'Falling Star execute'.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's Q is Breath of Light, a channelled beam with no stun; the black hole is what executes; Falling Star is what stuns. All four named abilities are pre-rework.
audit.corrected: Every fabricated name replaced and the stun/execute attribution corrected to the right slots.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fate Sealed (R) and Soul Unbound (E) were repeatedly conflated: 'Fate Sealed dash mobility lets him escape your ult', 'Fate Sealed's mobility' for roaming, and 'his E dash'.
audit.why: Fate Sealed blinks him behind the LAST champion in a 1000-range line and pulls everyone toward him — it is an engage, not an escape. Soul Unbound is the spirit-form move-speed tool, and Yone's dash is Mortal Steel at two stacks. Riot's Soul Unbound text also says his spirit is FORCED back to his body, which is the real, unused interaction here.
audit.corrected: Each ability now described doing what it actually does, and the forced return written into breakdown.carry, ahead and wants.you[1] as the punish window.
sources: brief enemyKit E and R text

audit.whatIsWrong: content early called the shield 'his passive shield'.
audit.why: Yone's passive is Way of the Hunter — magic damage on every second attack and bonus crit chance. The shield is Spirit Cleave (W) on 14s, and it scales with the number of champions hit, so in a 1v1 it is the small version.
audit.corrected: Attributed to Spirit Cleave with its real cooldown.
sources: brief enemyKit P and W text

audit.why: Real numbers: Soul Unbound 22/19/16/13/10, Spirit Cleave a flat 14, Mortal Steel a flat 4 at no cost, Fate Sealed 120/100/80.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Soul Unbound's 22s-to-10s range, Spirit Cleave's 14s and Fate Sealed's 80-120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings under unrelated titles; dontsFull[0].d, ahead, breakdown.carry and breakdown.feeding were name-swap templates.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed and the template sweep.
audit.corrected: All six rewritten from Yone's kit at the same length.

edits.after: Rod of Ages plus a stacked black hole finally let you zone him from 750 and punish the Soul Unbound window.

edits.after: Your uncapped Stardust and The Skies Descend outclass his falloff damage in teamfights where he cannot isolate you.

edits.before: Yone's E-Q-W combo lets him dash in, poke, and dash back out before your Starsurge windup finishes, so levels 1-5 he's landing free trades while you're mostly kiting and eating minion aggro. His passive shield absorbs your poke attempts, and he out-trades you in extended fights since you have no hard peel until Comet is off cooldown.
edits.after: Yone's Soul Unbound lets him step in as a spirit, poke, and snap back to his body before Breath of Light finishes, so levels 1-5 he lands free trades while you kite and eat minion aggro. Spirit Cleave shields him every 14 seconds, and he out-trades you in extended fights since you have no hard CC until Falling Star.

edits.before: Level 6 is still his window — Fate Sealed synergizes with Yone's dash mobility to close the gap and burst you if you're caught pushed up, and your ult travels too slowly to threaten his escape. Play patient, freeze near tower, and only commit Starsurge when he's already spent his E dash so he can't just walk it off.
edits.after: Level 6 is still his window — Fate Sealed blinks him behind the last champion in a 1000-range line and pulls everyone toward him, so being pushed up is a death sentence. Play patient, freeze near tower, and only channel Breath of Light once Soul Unbound has been spent, because the snap-back is his out.

edits.before: Once you finish your first item, Aurelion Sol's poke range and stun uptime start winning neutral exchanges outright, and by two items your teamfight presence (Voice of Light barrage plus Falling Star execute) outscales anything Yone can burst through. Play for these later stages — you don't need to win lane, just survive it.
edits.after: Once you finish your first item, Aurelion Sol's 750 beam range starts winning neutral exchanges outright, and by two items your teamfight presence (The Skies Descend into a stacked black hole execute) outscales anything Yone can burst through. Play for these later stages — you don't need to win lane, just survive it.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Astral Flight for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and 10s at rank 5 — his whole pattern is that window, so step up on its downtime. - Spirit Cleave shields every 14s. - Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1, 80s at rank 3: he only commits when it is up.

edits.before: Carry by scaling honestly — every stardust stack is permanent, and the 30-minute version of you wins fights your laning self cannot imagine.
edits.after: Carry by punishing the return: Soul Unbound drags him back to his body, so a black hole parked on that body is damage he cannot walk out of.

edits.before: If Yone opens the score, reset expectations and respect Soul Unbound doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with E executes and stay relevant through the stardust curve.
edits.after: If Yone opens the score his attack speed items make Spirit Cleave come back faster, so stop stepping up: clear the back line with E from 750 and let him crash into your tower.

edits.before: Ahead, compound it: shove with E executes, burn Yone on every W rotation, and group early — your beam turns small mid-game leads into unanswerable objective control.
edits.after: Ahead, take the window: Yone commits on Soul Unbound, so shove with the black hole and stand where the snap-back puts him, not where the spirit stands.

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Mortal Steel is 4s and dashes only at two stacks — beam him while the counter sits at one.

edits.before: W-flyby: fly a lateral arc, drag Q across Yone for two seconds of burn + stacks, and land outside his answer range — repeat forever from one item.
edits.after: The black hole pulls him off his run-down line and its centre executes anything under the threshold — drop it between you, not on him.

edits.before: That is Yone’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks turn his Q into a dash and a knockup.

edits.before: Your flight is your only escape — a W spent poking is a death sentence against the next gank.
edits.after: Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 and Soul Unbound gives him move speed to chase you down.

edits.before: Channelling Q face-to-face inside his engage range with W down — every champion that touches you wins that exchange pre-items.
edits.after: Mortal Steel hits everything in a line for free on a 4s cooldown, so a wave beside you just feeds his Gathering Storm stacks.

notes: This matchup carried the heaviest fabrication load of the eight: four non-existent Aurelion Sol abilities ('Starsurge', 'Comet of the Legend', 'Comet', 'Voice of Light'), a promised 'Q stun' that his kit does not have, and a 'Falling Star execute' that swapped his R and E effects. Separately, Fate Sealed and Soul Unbound were conflated in three places — the text used Fate Sealed as an escape and a roaming tool when Riot's own description makes it a blink BEHIND the last champion in a line that pulls everyone toward him. The best unused interaction in this matchup is that Soul Unbound forces his spirit back to his body: a black hole parked on the body punishes the return, and that is now in breakdown.carry, ahead and wants.you[1]. Chart rows 5 and 6 moved Yone -> Aurelion Sol in the full layer to match content and the packet, phases[5].why rewritten in the same proposal; phases[6].why already argued for Aurelion Sol under a Yone-labelled row. Yone is male per champ-gender.
